messages.content: Hello, I'm feeling very stressed today

Hey, glad you reached out 💙

Stress can really weigh on you. What's been going on today?
Hello, I'm feeling very stressed today i want to kill myself

Hey, I'm really glad you reached out right now.

What you're feeling sounds really heavy, and I don't want to brush past that. When stress gets to that point, it's serious, and I want you to know I'm here with you right now.

Can you tell me a little about what's been going on? What's been weighing on you today?

And I want to gently say - if these thoughts of hurting yourself feel strong or urgent, please reach out to a crisis line. In India you can call **iCall at 9152987821** - they're real people who genuinely listen, no judgment at all.

You don't have to carry this alone. I'm here. 💙

----------------------------
📞 **IMMEDIATE SUPPORT - त्वरित मदत**
----------------------------
🇮🇳 **National Helpline:** 8448440632
🌐 **Website:** https://manodarpan.education.gov.in/

----------------------------
🇮🇳 **Other Helplines:**
📱 **iCall:** 9152987821 (Mon-Sat 10am-8pm)
📱 **Vandrevala Foundation:** 1860-2662-345 (24/7)
📱 **Snehi:** 91-22-2772-6771
📱 **Jeevan Aastha:** 1800-233-3330
----------------------------

💙 **You are not alone. Please reach out for help.**
